verdict.rationale: YYLO is an open-source CLI orchestrator for coding agents with no evidence of a pricing/plan model, subscription tiers, or hosted service quotas—there's no plan-based pricing construct to have daily task or concurrency limits tied to. Concurrency is mentioned only as a technical feature (bounded fan-out), not as a plan-tier limit an engineering-lead manages against a subscription. This is a category error: the pricing-limits axis doesn't apply to a locally-installed CLI tool without a plan/billing system.
